page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 517
15/8/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

15th August 1916.

Sir,

It is reported that Deputy Military Governor
Lu is recruiting at Wusung, although he has no
authority from the Central Government to do so. He
has enrolled many of the ex-soldiers, who were
recently discharged by the revolutionists.

It is reported that General Yang will soon
leave for Peking.

The Special Police arrested yesterday a robber
who is said to be a member of a gang which operated
in the City.

Your obedient servant,

McMustrng
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Forwarded to Chief Constable
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
第 517 号
26/8/15

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916 年 8 月 15 日。

先生：

据报，卢副督军虽未获中央政府授权，仍在吴淞招兵。他已招募了许多近期被革命党人遣散的前士兵。

据报，杨将军即将启程前往北京。

特别警察队昨日逮捕了一名劫匪，据悉此人是曾在市内作案的一个团伙的成员。

您忠实的仆人，

McMustrng
首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

转呈总巡捕

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
No. 3179
16/8/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

16th August 1916.

Sir,

The Director of the Arsenal entertained Admiral Soh
Chen Ping, Generals Yang and Lu, Tseyin Chow and Yang
Tchong, Commissioner of Foreign Affairs, to dinner in the
Arsenal yesterday. They discussed the proposed transfer
of one of the torpedo boats to the North. Admiral Soh
said that Admiral Li had promised him to send three ships
to Canton to assist Lung Chi Kuang in restoring order there.
Admiral Li arrived at his new battle in the office of
the Chinese Navy in Shanghai yesterday.
Owing to high tide at the Chinese Bund yesterday,
several men were washed off their boats and two of them
were drowned.

Your obedient servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

6.15 a.m. 16.
page_data.zh:
刑事侦缉处
第 3179 号
16/8/16

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916 年 8 月 16 日。

先生：

兵工厂厂长昨日在兵工厂设宴款待苏镇平海军上将、杨将军和卢将军、周自齐（音译）和杨崇（音译）、以及外交特派员。他们讨论了将一艘鱼雷艇调往北方的提议。苏海军上将称，李海军上将已答应派遣三艘舰船前往广州，协助龙济光恢复当地秩序。李海军上将昨日抵达其在上海的中国海军办事处就任新职。
由于昨日外滩潮水高涨，数人从船上被冲落，其中两人溺亡。

您忠实的仆人，

William Armstrong
首席侦探督察。

警察总监。

上午 6:15，16 日。
